notes.title: Midnight Horror - Update - New Widescreen option.
notes.content:
Midnight Horror - Update 1.03 has been released, now featuring a new 16:9 monitor ratio option. 

When you Start the game you will be asked what format you want to play the game in, 1280 x 960 (HD 4:3 ratio) or 1280 x 720 (Widescreen 16:9 ratio)

What does that mean? Laptops, wide-screen monitors and big screens can now display the game FULL SCREEN with no black bars left and right. More importantly, laptop owners and those with a maximum screen height resolution of 720px can also now play the game too. 

•1280 x 960 (HD+ 4:3 ratio, for regular screen displays)
•1280 x 720 (Widescreen 16:9 ratio, for wide displays and laptops)

Both formats have Windowed or Full Screen modes, changed via Settings.

Note: Save games are not compatible between formats, sorry.

You will see V 1.03 displayed top left of the menu to show you are up to date.

notes.title: Midnight Horror - Update 1.01 has been released.
notes.content:
Midnight Horror - Update 1.01 has been released. If you see V 1.01 displayed top left of the menu, you are already up to date.

We’ve made a few improvements to gameplay to help people along.  Nigel will provide a few more helpful suggestions, but only a few (We don’t want to make it too easy), and Nigel will stop dancing when you’ve seen enough of him pulling shapes on the dance floor. 

The game is a HD format game, requiring gamers to have a display height on or over 960 PX high otherwise the game will not fit on screen. We are working on a SD version of the game that will be available shortly and will be included as part of a future update. The SD version will support a height of 768 PX or higher, as with the previous crown title - The Lost Crown: A ghost hunting adventure.
